activity.role: Vice-President of the Superior War Council
activity.notes: Ministerial decree dated 23 January 1920 appointed Pétain vice-president of the Conseil supérieur de la guerre; retired from that responsibility in 1931 and was succeeded by Weygand, exact terminal date unresolved. Separate overlapping Inspector-General duties from 1922 not silently equated to this office. Activity domain emphasis: military.
